name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, fueled by countless hours spent dissecting Formula 1 races and poring over engineering textbooks. After graduating top of his class from Istanbul Technical University with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he secured an internship at a local racing team, quickly proving his worth with his meticulous approach to problem-solving and innovative solutions. His career has been a steady climb, from junior engineer to lead mechanic, culminating in his current role as Chief Engineer at EVO Racing Team.

Deniz is known for his unwavering commitment to precision and his ability to extract maximum performance from the car through meticulous data analysis and optimization. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment within his team, encouraging open communication and the sharing of ideas. While demanding, Deniz is respected for his fairness and his willingness to mentor junior engineers. His relentless pursuit of perfection and his knack for finding that extra tenth of a second are what make him a valuable asset to any racing team. He's also developing simulation software in his free time.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Deniz is of medium build with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking Turkish coffee before every race.
